releaseNotes.zh-CN: 每组账号新增可选安全信息，可重复添加安全手机、安全邮箱或自定义名称，最多 16 条；支持编辑、移除、单独复制及 TXT 导出，列表默认折叠，离开窗口后重新折叠。编辑弹窗支持滚动并固定标题和保存按钮。安全信息随账号一起 DPAPI 加密保存；兼容旧数据，首次保存后升级文档结构，请勿降级到 0.1.1 或更旧模块。
releaseNotes.en-US: Optional per-account security fields: repeatable recovery phones, emails and custom labels (up to 16), editing, removal, individual copying and TXT export. Details fold on blur; the scrollable editor keeps its header and save actions visible. Fields use the existing user-scoped DPAPI storage. Legacy vaults load without rewriting; the first save upgrades their schema, so do not downgrade to 0.1.1 or older.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 界面全新设计：保险库状态卡与分类色标；搜索覆盖全部分类（Ctrl+F），仍不匹配密码；条目卡片显示域名链接与按名称着色的标识；显示密码时按钮外圈显示 30 秒自动隐藏倒计时，复制后按钮直接确认。隐私行为不变：默认隐藏、失焦即隐藏、由原生进程执行复制。
releaseNotes.en-US: Redesigned interface: vault status card and colour-coded categories; search across every category (Ctrl+F) that still never matches passwords; entry cards with host-only links and tinted monograms; a 30-second auto-hide ring while a password is shown and in-place copy confirmation. Privacy behaviour is unchanged.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 密码记事本首次公开预览：自定义分类、游戏/网站链接与备注，每个条目支持多组账号密码；分别复制账号或密码，默认 *** 隐藏，显示后 30 秒或失焦自动隐藏。支持当前分类/全部分类 TXT 明文导出，导出前确认风险。本机数据使用 Windows 当前用户 DPAPI 加密及原子保存。需要实现通用文件选择与弹窗接口的新版工具箱构建，早期同版本 0.3.4-alpha 可能缺少这些服务。
releaseNotes.en-US: First public Password Notes preview: categories, game/site links and notes, multiple accounts per entry, separate copying and masked passwords with explicit reveal and timed/blur hiding. Export the selected category or all categories to plaintext TXT after confirmation. User-scoped Windows DPAPI protects local storage with atomic saves. Requires generic file and popup host services; early 0.3.4-alpha builds may lack them.
